item.title: Pocket Poster v3.0
item.description:
Pocket Poster 3.0 | Pocket_Poster
# Features - Added an in-app explore page for finding and downloading wallpapers - Added custom CarPlay wallpapers (will not work on iOS 26.0) - *Preliminary* iOS 16 support (not all wallpapers will work) - Improved certain error messages
# Bug Fixes - Fixed the aspect ratio/rotation of imported custom videos - Fixed the update API not being called correctly - Fixed issues with some alerts not popping up - Other various app stability improvements
